subject: Request: Free credits exception for Angel Cohort — playbook & approval
messages:
From: Emma Li <emma@angelcohort.org>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 11 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request — free credits exception for Angel Cohort (pilot of 25 founders)

Hi Connor,

Quick note from the Angel Cohort team — we're launching a new summer intake (25 founders) and would love to extend Redwood's starter credits to this group as part of their onboarding. Historically we've used the standard starter package, but this batch includes several pre-revenue teams that would benefit from a one-time uplift.

Can Redwood make an exception for a 2x starter grant for this cohort (25 accounts) and provide a short approval playbook we can cite to our sponsors? If possible we'd also like a one-page summary to include in the cohort welcome packet.

Attached a short qualification note for the cohort (see AngelCohort_qualification_summary.pdf). Happy to hop on a quick call if helpful.

Thanks —
Emma Li
Program Manager, Angel Cohort
emma@angelcohort.org
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
To: Emma Li <emma@angelcohort.org>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 11 Jul 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request — free credits exception for Angel Cohort (pilot of 25 founders)

Thanks Emma — this is helpful context.

Looping in Lauren (growth ops) and Vanessa (partnerships) to assess whether we can offer a temporary uplift and to create the short approval/playbook you asked for. Two immediate questions that will help:

- Is the 2x uplift a one-time grant per account or pooled (shared among cohort seats)?
- Do any sponsors require invoiced credits or do we need a DocuSign addendum for accounting?

Proposed next steps: Lauren/Vanessa, can we (1) confirm guardrails (cap per org, time window, eligibility), (2) draft the one-page summary for Emma, and (3) capture a 2–3 step approval playbook so our CS and finance teams can process without ad-hoc escalation? I'll handle the coordination with the cohort.

Connor O'Brien
Partnerships | Redwood Inference
connor.obrien@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>, Emma Li <emma@angelcohort.org>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 11 Jul 2026 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request — free credits exception for Angel Cohort (pilot of 25 founders)

Connor / Emma — I can take point on the playbook draft. Early thoughts for guardrails (to avoid precedent creep):

- Eligibility: cohort-administered accounts only; must be paid-up sponsor or accepted non-profit partner.
- Cap: max 2x starter credits per account, with a hard cohort aggregate cap of 40x starter credits total for this program.
- Window: credits must be claimed within 90 days of issuance; unused credits do not roll forward.
- Sponsorship invoicing: if a sponsor wants to pay for credits, route to finance; otherwise credits are promotional and non-billable.

I'll pull a 1-page summary and a 2-step ops playbook (Request -> Eligibility check -> Grant issuance) and attach for review. Will include a suggested subject line and wording you can paste into your welcome packet.

I'll also flag Finance if we're asked to invoice sponsors (Ben C. usually handles). Vanessa — does partnerships want any different language for sponsor-facing comms?

Thanks,
Lauren Bishop
Growth Ops | Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwood.com
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>, Emma Li <emma@angelcohort.org>
Date: Sat, 11 Jul 2026 12:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request — Request — free credits exception for Angel Cohort (pilot of 25 founders)

Nice — I'll add partner-facing language. Two items to propose:

1) Offer structure: 2x starter credits per seat, but require cohort admin to create accounts within 30 days and to verify founders are active (simple survey OK). If a founder goes dormant for 60+ days we reclaim the credits.

2) Reduced friction ops path: I'll attach a draft playbook and approval checklist (playbook-draft-free-credits-exception.docx). Suggested approval authority: Partnerships lead sign-off + Growth Ops confirmation = auto-issue. Finance only if sponsor invoicing requested.

Quick redline suggestions: add explicit clause that these grants are promotional and not eligible for refunds or retroactive top-ups. Also recommend limiting exceptions to 2 cohorts per calendar year to control runway.

Emma — happy to provide the one-pager for the welcome packet. If you want, we can produce a short sponsor-facing blurb that references the criteria and provides a link to the cohort claim form.

Cheers,
Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Partnerships | Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
To: Emma Li <emma@angelcohort.org>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 11 Jul 2026 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request — free credits exception for Angel Cohort (pilot of 25 founders)

Appreciate the quick turnaround, team.

Emma — summary of what we're prepared to offer (pending your confirmation):
- 2x starter grant per founder account (one-time)
- Cohort pool cap: 40 starter grants total
- Accounts must be created and claimed within 30 days of issuance; credits expire at 90 days
- Dormancy reclaim policy and no refunds clause
- Approval: Partnerships lead + Growth Ops auto-issue; Finance involved only for sponsor invoicing/DocuSign

Attachments I'm sending internally: playbook draft + qualification summary. Next steps for you: confirm whether sponsors require invoicing or a DocuSign addendum, and whether cohort wants pooled credits or per-seat issuance. If you confirm pooled or per-seat by EOD Monday I'll get legal to ACK the wording and we'll publish the one-pager for your welcome packet.

If we need to invoice sponsors, can you loop procurement@angelcohort.org and cc the sponsor? That will speed Ben's review.

Connor
